sentences.text:
Appearance:
 Shri Manoj Kushwaha - Advocate for the applicant.

Mr. Satya Pal Chadar- G.A. for the State.
 Order

This is the first bail application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
2.

The applicant is in custody since 16.12.2024 in connection with Crime No.391/2024 registered at P.S.-Sihpur Police Chowki Raigwa, District-Satna (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468 and 471 of IPC.

3. Prosecution story, in brief, is that complainant Jitendra Singh had applied online in the year 2018 under Chief Minister Solar Pump Scheme before Kiosk Director/applicant Devendra Sharma and also deposited with application registration Fee of Rs.5,000/-.
Thereafter, complainant Jitendra Singh had also paid Rs.67,000/- to applicant Devendra Sharma and had also deposited various amounts with the applicant Devendra Sharma.

Applicant had taken sum of Rs.4,14,000/- from the complainant Jitendra Singh in the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:6371 2 MCRC-4882-2025 name of Chief Minister Solar Scheme and only a sum of Rs.5,000/- i.e application fees was deposited in the District Akshay Energy Office, Rewa and remaining amount was not deposited and applicant-Devendra Sharma misappropriated the remaining amount and deposited the same in his own account and has also issued forged receipts to the complainant Devendra Sharma vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 10 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/26265054/
1 Jitendra Singh.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant has not committed any crime.
Applicant is in jail since 16.12.2024.
No custodial interrogation is required in the case.
Applicant has been falsely implicated in the case on account of some previous rivalries.
Further, learned counsel for the applicant also submits that applicant is ready to deposit the amount of Rs.4,14,000/-.
On above grounds, it has been prayed that the applicant be released on bail pending the trial.
5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed grant of bail.

6. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case and subject to the condition that applicant shall deposit the sum of Rs.4,14,000/-, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, first bail application under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant-Devendra Sharma be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:6371 3 MCRC-4882-2025 during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
8. This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
9 . Soft copy of this bail order immediately/forthwith be sent to applicant through concerned Jail Superintendent.
10. Certified copy as per rules.

(ACHAL KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE Hashmi Devendra Sharma vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 10 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/26265054/
